answer: Each new agent must pass a proof-of-bandwidth test: it streams a 10 MB random payload to three validators through a separate network inlet within 20 seconds, repeated every 5 epochs. A farm of N fakes needs N independent uplinks, so 500 fakes move 5 GB per round and rent about 500 distinct IP blocks, cost linear in N, while an honest user pays once. Validators hash 8% of received payloads against their own copy; a mismatch slashes 55 of the agent's 80 POA bond. Fakes hiding in one meadow of shared servers collide on haven latency fingerprints.
